name: goals_parse_judge_response
notes: Judge-reply parser (traced copy of src/hermes_cli/goals_manager.c::goal_judge_parse_response + goal_judge_extract_json_object + extract_json vs LIVE hermes_cli/goals.py::_parse_judge_response). Cup hashes the branch ladder + final verdict label + wait-directive key (session_id/pid/seconds/none), NOT the formatted reason string: LIVE repr()/truncates the raw reply in 'judge reply was not JSON: ...' while C embeds it verbatim, a cosmetic divergence. Inputs avoid: whitespace-padded verdict values (' WAIT ' — C lowercases but does not strip), non-string non-bool 'verdict' fields (C json_get_str returns NULL -> legacy path; Python bool()s it -> done), fractional pid strings (atol truncates, int() raises). Inputs use literal \n escapes decoded by both sides.
